- <a id="inv-schema.constraint_enforced"></a>**`schema.constraint_enforced`** · schema — Every declared constraint holds on every write path: INSERT, UPDATE, upsert, COPY, merge and cherry-pick.
- <a id="inv-schema.ddl_atomic"></a>**`schema.ddl_atomic`** · schema — A failed DDL statement leaves no partial change.
- <a id="inv-schema.ddl_preserves_data"></a>**`schema.ddl_preserves_data`** · schema — ALTER changes existing values only as PostgreSQL would.
- <a id="inv-schema.index_transparent"></a>**`schema.index_transparent`** · schema — An index never changes a query's result.
- <a id="inv-schema.sequence_unique"></a>**`schema.sequence_unique`** · schema — nextval never returns a value twice, under concurrency too, and respects setval.
